steps.note: upstream #106 (33cdd577e): an init file repeating an id keeps the last entry, served from the first entry's place (its log, one creating expectation with the last entry, is checked on a reload in init_repeated_id_reload: at start it also holds the init-file lint WARN)
the kept (last) entry sits ahead of the middle one, so it answers the path both match

the init-file lint WARN: DUPLICATE_ID for the replaced first entry, and SHADOWED for the middle entry the kept one now serves ahead of (polled: the oracle's first lint of a file can take tens of seconds)

mask.replace: <startup warnings and the requests after them>
mask.reason: this step checks the entries before the startup warnings (the lint WARN, then the creating entries); 9.1.0's once-per-start warnings are not checked here
